heading: Bear spotted in village near Kerala’s Nenmara
author: Times News Network /  Sep 21, 2026, 21:41 IST
paragraphs: Palakkad: For the residents of Vithanassery village in Nenmara, Palakkad, stepping out of their homes after dark has become a matter of concern

Dealing already with the frequent straying of wild elephants, residents now have another reason to be wary as a bear was spotted near a house on Sunday.The bear was sighted around 9.30pm in a rubber plantation adjoining the house of Anish and Sabitha at Elanthankulambu

The family noticed the animal after their pet dog started barking continuously and raising an alarm.When the family stepped outside and flashed lights towards the plantation, the bear reportedly ran into the nearby forest
The family managed to capture visuals of the animal on a mobile phone.Residents said they were increasingly reluctant to venture outside in the dark
